source: Selected observable contracts from testdata/aws/dynamodb/backups.json; nativeSequence/nativeSupplementalSequence retain provenance.
assumptions: Native times and resource IDs are rebound; initial RestoreSummary uses backup-origin time, not restore admission time. Settled RestoreSummary is absent.
Polling repeats only DescribeBackup/DescribeTable readiness. Source mutations are deliberately issued after backup admission but before backup polling.
Local lifecycle extensions advance 25h past source deletion, verify stream expiry, reopen both stores, and restore from the surviving duplicate backup after deleting its sibling.
Default restore omits both index override fields; excluded restore preserves explicit empty arrays. Tags, enabled TTL and streams remain source features, not restored settings.
Complete typed item outputs are native canonical numeric lexemes; only sets and Scan item order are normalized. Query item/list order remains significant.

Pagination checks exact ARN order and cursor exhaustion. Native backup_list_time_precision captures inclusive time bounds and range validation after millisecond rounding. Warm capacity and asynchronous item/size statistics are not pinned.

backup_on_demand_restore.json supplies omitted provisioned override failures, default inherited maximums, pending/settled counter presence, and the accepted renamed GSI. Its empty-table experiment is extended locally with a copied item queried through the renamed index.
backup_index_overrides.json rejects changed GSI key schemas and projections without creating a target; a rename alone remains accepted.

Restore history cases use backup_restore_bootstrap.indexExperiment calls 14/58 and 17/62: base 2/20 with index 4/2, and base 4/2 with index 3/20. Each resource independently reports an increase at the observed read-capacity boundary; its increase and decrease timestamps agree.

Request admission uses documented nominal operation rates and service-time refill. Native single-connection and pipeline captures establish ListBackups burst/recovery, filter sharing and throttle precedence over Limit=0 validation. Scoped region/operation isolation is a local invariant, not a claim to reproduce native multi-connection fleet allocation. Throttled audit fields come from backup_request_admission_audit source sequence 19.
